intent_candidates.source_of_truth: native development, memory, social, world-model, routine and temporal proposal sources

base_candidates.source_of_truth: existing ordinary candidate construction in Arbitrator.select

preventive_signal.source_of_truth: existing urgency calculation relative to BOUNDS ideals, excluding active_recovery_needs and critical_any

hard_recovery.source_of_truth: existing active_recovery_needs or critical_any path before ordinary candidate construction
hard_recovery.translation: existing recovery path returns before interruptible-intent eligibility

hard_recovery_candidates.source_of_truth: existing recovery candidate generation, authority_effect_branches, candidate_is_admissible and immediate safety

authority_valid.source_of_truth: body capability status, verified authority effect branches and recovery contracts
authority_valid.translation: candidate filtering before final action arbitration

immediately_safe.translation: candidate filtering before preventive admission and final fallback

regulatory_dimensions.source_of_truth: verified_outcome_effects relative to existing BOUNDS ideals plus existing visible toward/from route semantics
regulatory_dimensions.translation: derived per decision; no authored capability-to-need labels

behavioral_deduplication.source_of_truth: capability plus behaviorally relevant params; provenance keys excluded
behavioral_deduplication.translation: canonical source-order-independent intent and mixed eligibility set

final_action_arbitration.production_function: score_candidate, existing modifiers, bounded RNG argmax, anti-thrash and _commit
final_action_arbitration.translation: one final selected Candidate proceeds to existing Governance/Embodiment path

NO_SAFE_ACTION.source_of_truth: existing final authority fallback after all candidates are rejected
NO_SAFE_ACTION.translation: preventive attention alone never empties a valid intent set and does not manufacture the sentinel

states.STATE_3_INTENT_ACTIVE_PREVENTIVE_REGULAT: admissible_intents plus authority-valid matching regulatory base candidates
states.STATE_4_NO_INTENT_PREVENTIVE_REGULATORY_: authority-valid matching regulatory base candidates, with established base fallback if none exists
states.STATE_5_ACTIVE_OR_CRITICAL_RECOVERY: existing recovery path, before this contract
